{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: 1
  HAPPO_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HAPPO_API_KEY }}
  HAPPO_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HAPPO_API_SECRET }}
  pnpm_config_store_dir: ./.cache/pnpm

jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        node-version: [22, 24]

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: Test (Node ${{ matrix.node-version }} on ${{ matrix.os }})
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Log environment variables
        run: node -e "console.log(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(process.env).sort()), null, 2))"
      - run: pnpm test --coverage

  orchestrate-happo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Orchestrate Happo Job
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: ./.github/actions/orchestrate-happo
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          happo-api-key: ${{ secrets.HAPPO_API_KEY }}
          happo-api-secret: ${{ secrets.HAPPO_API_SECRET }}
          projects: 'cypress,storybook-v8,storybook-v9,storybook-v10,storybook-skipped,storybook-only,storybook-no-register,playwright,playwright-nonce,custom,custom-skipped,pages'

  cypress:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Cypress
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-cypress
      - run: pnpm test:cypress

  custom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Happo Custom
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm test:custom

  custom-skipped:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Happo Custom (skipped examples)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm test:custom:skipped

  pages:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Happo Pages
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm test:pages

  storybook-v8:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Storybook v8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm add -D storybook@8 @storybook/react@8 @storybook/builder-vite@8 @storybook/react-vite@8
      - run: pnpm test:storybook:v8

  storybook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - version: 9
            dependencies: 'storybook@9 @storybook/builder-vite@9 @storybook/react-vite@9'
          - version: 10
            dependencies: ''

    name: Storybook v${{ matrix.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - if: matrix.dependencies != ''
        run: pnpm add -D ${{ matrix.dependencies }}
      - run: pnpm test:storybook
        env:
          HAPPO_STORYBOOK_VERSION: ${{ matrix.version }}

  storybook-skipped:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Storybook (skipped examples)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # getSkip.ts diffs against the base commit to avoid skipping changed story files
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm test:storybook:skipped

  storybook-only:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Storybook (only examples)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm test:storybook:only

  storybook-no-register:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Storybook (no register import)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm test:storybook:no-register

  playwright:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Playwright
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-playwright
      - run: pnpm test:playwright

  playwright-nonce:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Playwright (nonce)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-playwright
      - run: pnpm test:playwright:nonce
        env:
          HAPPO_NONCE: ${{ github.run_id }}

  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: TypeScript
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm tsc

  eslint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: ESLint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ./.cache/pnpm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-env
      - run: pnpm lint",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly installs pnpm dependencies across many jobs (pnpm-lock.yaml exists and pnpm_config_store_dir already points to ./.cache/pnpm), matching the dependency-download caching pattern. Adding actions/cache@v4, keyed on hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') and restored before setup-env installs, preserves every test/check while reducing repeated install time.
